scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'cd apps/api && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; elif [ -x ../../venv/bin/python ]; then ../../venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi'
scripts.dev:worker: sh -c 'cd apps/worker && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python main.py; elif [ -x ../../venv/bin/python ]; then ../../venv/bin/python main.py; else python3 main.py; fi'
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:stack: docker compose up api worker redis --build
scripts.check:api: sh -c 'cd apps/api && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -c "from app.main import app; print(app.title)"; elif [ -x ../../venv/bin/python ]; then ../../venv/bin/python -c "from app.main import app; print(app.title)"; else python3 -c "from app.main import app; print(app.title)"; fi'
scripts.test:api: sh -c 'cd apps/api && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest; elif [ -x ../../venv/bin/python ]; then ../../venv/bin/python -m pytest; else python3 -m pytest; fi'
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
